title_en: Four Months the Wedding Is Being Prepared
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear (lively wedding song, possibly modern); no author named. 'Нунко' is rendered 'godfather' (my reading; nunko is the wedding sponsor/godfather in Macedonian usage).

lines.cyr: Четири месеци свадба се спрема,
lines.lat: Četiri meseci svadba se sprema,
lines.en: Four months the wedding is being prepared,

lines.cyr: а свекорот ракија нема.
lines.lat: a svekorot rakija nema.
lines.en: but the father-in-law has no brandy.

lines.cyr: а дедото гајле си нема.
lines.lat: a dedoto gajle si nema.
lines.en: but the grandfather has no care.

lines.cyr: Пиј свекре пиј, да се напиеш,
lines.lat: Pij svekre pij, da se napieš,
lines.en: Drink, father-in-law, drink, drink your fill,

lines.cyr: денес ти е денот да се веселиш.
lines.lat: denes ti e denot da se veseliš.
lines.en: today is your day to make merry.
